mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO following (id, from_user_id, to_user_id, rel_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{relStatus}, NOW(3), NOW(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE following SET rel_status=1, updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE from_user_id=#{fromUserId} AND to_user_id=#{toUserId} AND rel_status<>1
UPDATE following SET rel_status=0, updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE from_user_id=#{fromUserId} AND to_user_id=#{toUserId} AND rel_status<>0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO follower (id, to_user_id, from_user_id, rel_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{toUserId}, #{fromUserId}, #{relStatus}, #{createdAt}, NOW(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at=IF(rel_status <> VALUES(rel_status) OR created_at <> VALUES(created_at), VALUES(updated_at), updated_at), created_at=VALUES(created_at), rel_status=VALUES(rel_status)
mapper.update: UPDATE follower SET rel_status=0, updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE to_user_id=#{toUserId} AND from_user_id=#{fromUserId} AND rel_status<>0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM following WHERE from_user_id=#{fromUserId} AND to_user_id=#{toUserId} AND rel_status=1

SELECT from_user_id FROM follower WHERE to_user_id=#{toUserId} AND rel_status=1 ORDER BY created_at DESC, from_user_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT to_user_id AS toUserId, created_at AS createdAt FROM following WHERE from_user_id=#{fromUserId} AND rel_status=1 ORDER BY created_at DESC, to_user_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM following WHERE from_user_id=#{fromUserId} AND rel_status=1
